english.note: This is the all-purpose choice for something happening quickly and with little or no warning.
This is the all-purpose choice for something happening suddenly and without warning.
This is the all-purpose Cantonese choice for an abrupt or sudden reaction.

examples.english: I suddenly forgot to bring my keys.
examples.jyutping: ngo5 dat6 jin4 m4 gei3 dak1 daai3 so2 si4

examples.english: They left abruptly, and nobody knew what was going on.
examples.traditional: 佢突然走咗，大家都唔知咩事。
examples.jyutping: keoi5 dat6 jin4 zau2 zo2 daai6 gaa1 dou1 m4 zi1 me1 si6

examples.english: They sharply stopped talking, and everyone froze.
examples.traditional: 佢突然間唔出聲，成班人都呆咗。
examples.jyutping: keoi5 dat6 jin4 gaan1 m4 ceot1 seng1 sing4 baan1 jan4 dou1 ngoi4 zo2
